request.description: a grand pair of phoenix feather wings, ivory and rich gold layered plumage with bright orange feather tips, a tiny gold central back clasp. Exactly two LARGE WINGS only, standalone wearable back accessory, no character, no person, no head, no torso, no mannequin. Oblique three-quarter front-right view for a character looking slightly right. Entire silhouette inside canvas with 5 pixel padding, fixed centered composition. Crisp low resolution fantasy RPG pixel art, chunky readable pixel clusters, limited palette, single dark pixel outline, basic shading, no anti-aliasing, no smooth gradients. Transparent background. One static pose, no animation, no ground shadow.
